Backend Processing

The Vendor Management Dashboard will retrieve summary statistics and vendor information from the FastAPI backend.

  • Retrieve dashboard statistics.
  • Retrieve vendor records.
  • Retrieve approval status.
  • Retrieve vendor categories.
  • Communicate with PostgreSQL.
  • Return data to the Angular application.

Audit Information

/* Every vendor record maintains audit information for tracking changes throughout the vendor lifecycle.*/

  • Created By
  • Created Date
  • Last Updated By
  • Last Updated Date
  • Approved By
  • Approved Date

Database Relationships

Vendor information is stored using relational database design to avoid duplicate data and maintain referential integrity.

  • One Vendor → Multiple Purchase Orders
  • One Vendor → Multiple Procurement Records
  • One Vendor → Multiple Uploaded Documents
  • One Vendor → Multiple Contracts (Future Module)

Procurement Integration

Only vendors with the following conditions will be available for Procurement Management.

  • Approval Status = Approved
  • Vendor Status = Active

Pending, Rejected, Suspended, or Inactive vendors will not appear during vendor selection in Procurement.

Future Module Integration

Vendor information maintained in this module will be shared with upcoming modules.
